propositions: A new advisory, AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' detects layer-cake decompositions (children partitioned by architectural layer) which are un-demoable alone and defer integration risk.

The criterion detects consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns where a child names/consumes an artifact a sibling produces without an explicit ordering dependency (depends_on/blocks), allowing parallel schedulers to start consumers before producers.

The criterion is registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), routed via criteria_routing.json as advisory container-facet, and integrated into CONTAINER_CRITERIA fan-out in pass1.py without requiring new engine constructs.

The eval_solver is extended to run container criteria via pass1_container for fixtures with a children: list, enabling bounded sanity harness testing of decomp-shape and existing container criteria G3/G4.

Blocking promotion is deferred via double-gating: criterion effectiveness must clear thresholds AND E6's order-stability must exceed floor (fleiss_kappa >= 0.6), which currently fails as a prerequisite for R3.

Bounded sanity testing on four hand-authored fixtures (layer-cake positive, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge positive, vertical-slice negative, ordered producer/consumer negative) achieves recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives.
